# Closet

> Private, self-hosted household wardrobe organizer. Catalog garments with photos, build outfits, schedule them on a calendar, and share a wardrobe between users.

## What It Is

Closet is a self-hosted fork of Libre Closet (AGPL-3.0). It runs as a server-rendered progressive web app on your own hardware; data stays in a local SQLite or PostgreSQL database.

## Routes

- /wardrobe - garment catalog
- /outfits - saved outfits and the outfit builder
- /calendar - outfit schedule
- /about - about and license attribution
- /auth/login - sign in (when authentication is enabled)

## Tech Stack

- NestJS on Fastify (TypeScript), Handlebars templates
- htmx + hyperscript, Tailwind + daisyUI
- SQLite or PostgreSQL via MikroORM
- Client-side background removal (ONNX runtime)
- Workbox service worker, Web Push
- Local disk or S3-compatible file storage
